title: Rune relay startup configuration
description: Optional settings for the standalone Rune relay. TCP carries control messages; negotiated UDP carries realtime data on the same endpoint. Omitted properties retain built-in defaults; command-line settings override file settings. The relay validates numeric endpoints and max_rooms <= max_connections both when loading the file and after command-line overrides, before listening.

listen.description: Numeric IPv4:port or bracketed [IPv6]:port endpoint. The relay validates the address and port range 0..65535; port 0 chooses a free port.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous TCP connections, including clients outside rooms.

max_rooms.description: Maximum simultaneous rooms. Must not exceed max_connections in the file's settings with omitted defaults applied, and again after command-line overrides.

timeout_seconds.description: Idle time in seconds before disconnecting a connection.

packets_per_second.description: Combined per-connection TCP frame and authenticated UDP datagram limit, including control messages and binding heartbeats.

udp_enabled.description: Listen for authenticated, negotiated UDP realtime data on the same address and port as TCP. Clients using TCP only remain supported.

run_seconds.description: Stop after this many seconds. Omit to run indefinitely; fractional seconds are allowed.
